explication: MXC is a cross-platform sandboxed code-execution system exposed through Rust, .NET, and Node SDKs. The documented workflow is application request → SDK validation and backend selection → isolated workload; requests carry containment and security policies, and persistent workloads can use a provision/start/execute/stop/deprovision lifecycle. The graph also preserves native FFI, backend-specific lifecycle services, telemetry, and diagnostics. Relationship evidence is limited to the README and the supplied source excerpts/index; unsampled backend wiring is not expanded into guessed calls.
